title: Holding my Grandson
synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.

fullText.simplified:
难怪王老太太想要孙子呀，不为了抱孙子，要儿媳妇来干嘛？
    也不能怪儿媳妇每天着急。本来嘛，不是她不努力，而是她怀的孩子要不是生下来不活，就是不活着生下来，她有什么办法呢？
    就拿第一个孩子来说吧。自从怀孕，王老太太就不让儿媳妇有任何动作，晚上睡觉都不让她动一下。够小心的了吧？哪里知道，到了五个多月，儿媳妇可能是因为多眨了几次眼睛吧，孩子没了，还是个男孩。
    再说第二个孩子吧。儿媳妇连眨眼睛都不太敢眨，打喷嚏的时候也有下人左右陪着。果然，小心一点儿没错，生了一个大胖小子。可是没活了五天，孩子不知道为什么，竟然没了。那是十一月的天气，房间里放着四个火盆，窗户也关着，不要说风了，就是风神，想进来也挺不容易的。而且孩子还有四床厚厚的被子，应该够暖和的了吧？哼！他竟然死了！这能怪谁？只能说那孩子命该如此。
    现在，儿媳妇又有喜了，肚子大得不得了。王老太太看着儿媳妇的大肚子，高兴得不得了，心里想着：求子孙娘娘给我们王家一个大胖小子吧！
    王老太太可不只是求子孙娘娘，她对儿媳妇可好了。就算儿媳妇想要吃星星吃月亮，估计王老太太也会想办法弄给她吃。大晚上的，王老太太还给儿媳妇送鸡腿、送鸡肉面……儿媳妇想吃什么就有什么。儿媳妇也很给面子，越躺在床上越饿，吃完了这个还想吃那个。孕妇不多吃，怎么能生出大胖小子呢？王老太太和儿媳妇对于这一点，是完全同意的。
    婆婆这样，儿媳妇的娘家人当然更要对自己女儿好了！娘家妈每周都来看女儿，每次来都带着大包小包好吃的。婆婆和娘家妈，按理来说，就是对仇人。娘家妈带来的东西越多，婆婆越觉得是看不起她；婆婆越给儿媳妇吃东西，娘家妈就越觉得女儿没有吃够。
    儿媳妇乐得婆婆和娘家妈这样争来争去，因为这样，她每天就都有好吃的了。儿媳妇吃得越多，王老太太越高兴，好像已经看到了肚子里的大胖小子一样。可是，产婆已经在儿媳妇身边七天了，儿媳妇就是生不出来。王老太太求子孙娘娘求了七天了，上了很多香，还是没用。
    到了第八天，儿媳妇连鸡汤都不喝了，疼得大叫。王老太太急得给子孙娘娘上香，娘家妈把神婆请了过来作法，还是没用。
fullText.traditional:
難怪王老太太想要孫子呀，不為了抱孫子，要兒媳婦來幹嘛？
    也不能怪兒媳婦每天著急。本來嘛，不是她不努力，而是她懷的孩子要不是生下來不活，就是不活著生下來，她有什麼辦法呢？
    就拿第一個孩子來說吧。自從懷孕，王老太太就不讓兒媳婦有任何動作，晚上睡覺都不讓她動一下。夠小心的了吧？哪裏知道，到了五個多月，兒媳婦可能是因為多眨了幾次眼睛吧，孩子沒了，還是個男孩。
    再說第二個孩子吧。兒媳婦連眨眼睛都不太敢眨，打噴嚏的時候也有下人左右陪著。果然，小心一點兒沒錯，生了一個大胖小子。可是沒活了五天，孩子不知道為什麼，竟然沒了。那是十一月的天氣，房間裡放著四個火盆，窗戶也關著，不要說風了，就是風神，想進來也挺不容易的。而且孩子還有四床厚厚的被子，應該夠暖和的了吧？哼！他竟然死了！這能怪誰？只能說那孩子命該如此。
    現在，兒媳婦又有喜了，肚子大得不得了。王老太太看著兒媳婦的大肚子，高興得不得了，心裡想著：求子孫娘娘給我們王家一個大胖小子吧！
    王老太太可不只是求子孫娘娘，她對兒媳婦可好了。就算兒媳婦想要吃星星吃月亮，估計王老太太也會想辦法弄給她吃。大晚上的，王老太太還給兒媳婦送雞腿、送雞肉麵……兒媳婦想吃什麼就有什麼。兒媳婦也很給面子，越躺在床上越餓，吃完了這個還想吃那個。孕婦不多吃，怎麼能生出大胖小子呢？王老太太和兒媳婦對於這一點，是完全同意的。
    婆婆這樣，兒媳婦的娘家人當然更要對自己女兒好了！娘家媽每週都來看女兒，每次來都帶著大包小包好吃的。婆婆和娘家媽，按理來說，就是對仇人。娘家媽帶來的東西越多，婆婆越覺得是看不起她；婆婆越給兒媳婦吃東西，娘家媽就越覺得女兒沒有吃夠。
    兒媳婦樂得婆婆和娘家媽這樣爭來爭去，因為這樣，她每天就都有好吃的了。兒媳婦吃得越多，王老太太越高興，好像已經看到了肚子裡的大胖小子一樣。可是，產婆已經在兒媳婦身邊七天了，兒媳婦就是生不出來。王老太太求子孫娘娘求了七天了，上了很多香，還是沒用。
    到了第八天，兒媳婦連雞湯都不喝了，疼得大叫。王老太太急得給子孫娘娘上香，娘家媽把神婆請了過來作法，還是沒用。

sentences.traditional: 婆婆越給兒媳婦吃東西，娘家媽就越覺得女兒沒有吃夠。
sentences.pinyin: pó po yuè gěi ér xí fu chī dōng xi niáng jia mā jiù yuè jué de nǚ ér méi yǒu chī gòu
sentences.english: The more the mother-in-law fed her daughter-in-law, the more the mother felt that her daughter hadn’t eaten enough.

sentences.simplified: 儿媳妇乐得婆婆和娘家妈这样争来争去，
sentences.traditional: 兒媳婦樂得婆婆和娘家媽這樣爭來爭去，
sentences.pinyin: ér xí fu lè de pó po hé niáng jia mā zhè yàng zhēng lái zhēng qù
sentences.english: The daughter-in-law was happy that her mother and mother-in-law argued like this, ..

sentences.simplified: 因为这样，她每天就都有好吃的了。
sentences.traditional: 因為這樣，她每天就都有好吃的了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè yàng tā měi tiān jiù dōu yǒu hǎo chī de le
sentences.english: .. because this way, she would eat well every day.

sentences.simplified: 儿媳妇吃得越多，王老太太越高兴，
sentences.traditional: 兒媳婦吃得越多，王老太太越高興，
sentences.pinyin: ér xí fu chī de yuè duō wáng lǎo tài tai yuè gāo xìng
sentences.english: The more her daughter-in-law ate, the happier Old Lady Wang became, ..

sentences.simplified: 好像已经看到了肚子里的大胖小子一样。
sentences.traditional: 好像已經看到了肚子裡的大胖小子一樣。
sentences.pinyin: hǎo xiàng yǐ jīng kàn dào le dù zi lǐ de dà pàng xiǎo zi yí yàng
sentences.english: .. like she could already see the big fat boy in the belly.

sentences.simplified: 可是，产婆已经在儿媳妇身边七天了，
sentences.traditional: 可是，產婆已經在兒媳婦身邊七天了，
sentences.pinyin: kě shì chǎn pó yǐ jīng zài ér xí fu shēn biān qī tiān le
sentences.english: However, the midwife had already been with the daughter-in-law for seven days.

sentences.simplified: 儿媳妇就是生不出来。
sentences.traditional: 兒媳婦就是生不出來。
sentences.pinyin: ér xí fu jiù shì shēng bù chū lái
sentences.english: The daughter-in-law still hadn’t given birth.

sentences.simplified: 王老太太求子孙娘娘求了七天了，上了很多香，还是没用。
sentences.traditional: 王老太太求子孫娘娘求了七天了，上了很多香，還是沒用。
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai qiú zǐ sūn niáng niang qiú le qī tiān le shàng le hěn duō xiāng hái shi méi yòng
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang prayed to the goddess of fertility for seven days and lit a lot of incense. But it didn’t work.

sentences.simplified: 到了第八天，儿媳妇连鸡汤都不喝了，疼得大叫。
sentences.traditional: 到了第八天，兒媳婦連雞湯都不喝了，疼得大叫。
sentences.pinyin: dào le dì bā tiān ér xí fu lián jī tāng dōu bù hē le téng de dà jiào
sentences.english: On the eighth day, the daughter-in-law wouldn’t even drink chicken soup. She bellowed in pain.

sentences.simplified: 王老太太急得给子孙娘娘上香，
sentences.traditional: 王老太太急得給子孫娘娘上香，
sentences.pinyin: wáng lǎo tài tai jí de gěi zǐ sūn niáng niang shàng xiāng
sentences.english: Old Lady Wang hurried to light incense for the goddess of fertility.

sentences.simplified: 娘家妈把神婆请了过来作法，还是没用。
sentences.traditional: 娘家媽把神婆請了過來作法，還是沒用。
sentences.pinyin: niáng jia mā bǎ shén pó qǐng le guò lái zuò fǎ hái shì méi yòng
sentences.english: The daughter-in-law’s mother invited a sorceress over to perform magic. But it didn’t work.

raw.synopsis: Old Lady Wang’s daughter-in-law has already lost two babies. Will her daughter-in-law’s third pregnancy give her the grandson that she’s always wanted.
sentence_translations: It’s not surprising that Old Lady Wang wanted to have a grandson.
If not to have a grandson, what do you need a daughter-in-law for?
And you can’t blame her daughter-in-law for feeling anxious every day.
It goes without saying that it wasn’t because she wasn’t trying, ..
.. but that the grandsons she conceived either died after birth or were born dead. What could she do?
Just take the first child. Ever since she became pregnant, Old Lady Wang would not let her daughter-in-law move at all.
Even at night when she slept, she wasn’t allowed to move. That’s careful enough right?
Who could have known that after a little over five months, ..
.. the daughter-in-law, perhaps because she blinked her eye a few times, lost her child, and it was also a boy.
And take the second child.
The daughter-in-law didn’t even dare blink her eye, and when she sneezed she had servants nearby accompanying her.
Sure enough, being a little more careful worked and she gave birth to a big fat boy.
However, when he had lived for less than five days, the child unexpectedly died for an unknown reason.
It was November weather. Four fire pans were placed inside the room and the windows were also closed.
Not to mention the wind, even the god of the wind would not find it easy to get in.
Also, the child had four thick layers of quilting. That ought to be sufficiently warm, right?
Humph! He died unexpectedly! Who could be blamed for that?
We can only say that the child’s fate was supposed to be like this.
Now, the daughter-in-law was expecting again. Her belly was extremely large.
Old Lady Wang, looking at her daughter-in-law’s large belly, was extremely happy.
She thought to herself: May the goddess of fertility grant our Wang family a big fat boy!
Old Lady Wang not only entreated the goddess of fertility, she also treated her daughter-in-law very well.
Even if her daughter-in-law wanted to eat the stars or the moon, ..
.. we suppose that Old Lady Wang would think of a way to let her eat it.
At night, Old Lady Wang also delivered to her daughter-in-law chicken legs, chicken noodles …
Her daughter-in-law would have whatever she wanted to eat.
The daughter-in-law also readily gave face.
The more she lay in bed, the hungrier she got. After eating something, she wanted to eat something else.
If a pregnant woman doesn’t eat a lot, how can she give birth to a big fat son?
With regards to this point, Old Lady Wang and her daughter-in-law were in complete agreement.
If the mother-in-law was like that, the daughter-in-law’s own family of course had to treat their own daughter even better!
The daughter-in-law’s mother came every week to see her daughter.
Every time she would bring big and small containers of tasty food.
According to reason, the mother and mother-in-law were enemies.
The more things that the mother brought, the more the mother-in-law felt that she was being looked down upon.
The more the mother-in-law fed her daughter-in-law, the more the mother felt that her daughter hadn’t eaten enough.
The daughter-in-law was happy that her mother and mother-in-law argued like this, ..
.. because this way, she would eat well every day.
The more her daughter-in-law ate, the happier Old Lady Wang became, ..
.. like she could already see the big fat boy in the belly.
However, the midwife had already been with the daughter-in-law for seven days.
The daughter-in-law still hadn’t given birth.
Old Lady Wang prayed to the goddess of fertility for seven days and lit a lot of incense. But it didn’t work.
On the eighth day, the daughter-in-law wouldn’t even drink chicken soup. She bellowed in pain.
Old Lady Wang hurried to light incense for the goddess of fertility.
The daughter-in-law’s mother invited a sorceress over to perform magic. But it didn’t work.
